---
title: "List Your Services on the HiiFest Vendor Directory"
sidebarTitle: "List Services"
description: "Join the HiiFest vendor directory to put your event services in front of organizers across Indonesia — from AV and catering to photography and more."
---

HiiFest connects event organizers with the service providers they need to make their events happen. By listing your services on the HiiFest Vendor Directory, you put your business directly in front of organizers planning concerts, conferences, weddings, corporate events, and more across Indonesia. Every inquiry you receive comes from an organizer who has already seen your work and chosen to reach out — no cold pitching required.

## Create your vendor account and first listing

<Steps>
  <Step title="Register as a vendor">
    Go to [platform.hiifest.app/auth/register](https://platform.hiifest.app/auth/register). When prompted to choose your account type, select **"Offer services"**. Complete the sign-up form with your email address and a password, then verify your email to activate your account.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Complete your vendor profile">
    Fill in your vendor profile — this is the public-facing page organizers see when they discover your listing:
    - **Business name** — the trading name you want displayed on HiiFest
    - **Contact details** — email, phone number, and city/region
    - **About section** — a short introduction to your business, your experience, and the clients or events you've worked with

    A complete profile builds trust with organizers before they even open your service listing.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Create your first service listing">
    From your vendor dashboard, click **Add Service Listing**. Fill in the core listing fields:
    - **Service name** — a clear, specific title (e.g. "Professional Event Photography – Jakarta")
    - **Category** — choose the category that best fits your service (see below)
    - **Description** — explain what you offer, your process, and what makes you stand out
    - **Pricing and packages** — add your pricing structure (see pricing strategies below)
  </Step>
  <Step title="Upload portfolio photos">
    Add at least three to five high-quality photos that showcase your work. Portfolio images are the first thing organizers notice and the most important factor in driving inquiries. Include a variety of shots: setup/behind-the-scenes, in-action, and final results.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Publish your listing">
    Review all the details, then click **Publish Listing**. Your service goes live in the HiiFest Vendor Directory immediately and becomes searchable by organizers browsing for providers in your category and city.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Choose the right service category

Selecting the most accurate category ensures your listing appears in the right searches. HiiFest supports the following vendor categories:

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="AV & Sound" icon="volume-high">
    Sound systems, mixing boards, microphones, speaker hire, and full AV production.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Catering" icon="utensils">
    Food and beverage services, buffet setups, food trucks, and bartending.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Photography & Videography" icon="camera">
    Event photography, videography, live streaming, and photo booths.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Stage & Lighting" icon="lightbulb">
    Stage builds, trussing, LED walls, intelligent lighting rigs, and laser shows.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Decoration" icon="star">
    Floral arrangements, themed décor, balloon installations, and branded setups.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Transportation" icon="bus">
    Guest shuttles, VIP transfers, logistics vehicles, and airport pickups.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Security" icon="shield">
    Crowd management, access control, bodyguards, and event security teams.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Entertainment" icon="music">
    Live bands, DJs, MCs, performers, and interactive entertainment acts.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

You can create multiple listings under different categories if your business offers more than one type of service.

## Write a great service description

Your description is your sales pitch — organizers read it to decide whether to send an inquiry. Follow these guidelines to write one that converts:

- **Lead with your speciality.** State clearly what you do and who you serve in the first two sentences.
- **Highlight experience and credentials.** Mention years in business, notable events you've worked on, or certifications relevant to your field.
- **Describe your process.** Walk the organizer through what working with you looks like, from initial brief to delivery on the day.
- **Be specific about geography.** State the cities or regions you operate in so organizers know whether you're available for their event location.
- **End with a call to action.** Invite organizers to send an inquiry and mention your typical response time.

## Set your pricing structure

HiiFest supports three common pricing models — choose the one that fits your business:

| Model | Best for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **Per package** | Services with defined tiers | Basic / Standard / Premium photography packages |
| **Per day / per hour** | Hire-based services | Sound equipment hire at Rp 2,500,000/day |
| **Custom quote** | Complex or bespoke services | Full stage build — quote on request |

You can combine models within a single listing. For example, offer two fixed packages and a "custom quote" option for large-scale requests.

<Tip>
  Listings with **five or more portfolio photos** receive significantly more organizer inquiries than listings with fewer images. Upload your best work before publishing — and refresh your portfolio regularly with recent events to keep your listing feeling current.
</Tip>
